snippet.title: Wildekin Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wildekin is a 3D pixel-art adventure where up to 4 friends can build, explore, survive and thrive—or at least try to, before some creature tries to turn you into a light snack! Coming to Xbox and PC.

Wishlist on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/wildekin/9N3WZX4CNWRX

You've fallen out of the sky with nothing but your wits, fists, and an overwhelming urge to redecorate. Explore and survive in a perilous wilderness, construct your town, and befriend lost Wildekin in a 1-4 player online multiplayer adventure.

Wildekin will be available in English and available on Game Pass from day one.

Developed by Cute Newt & published by Chucklefish.
